subject: CVPR Coffee
text:
Hi [NAME],

I saw you're hiring so thought you'll be at CVPR this year - and if so, I'd
love to introduce myself in person. We've been working on projects w/
Synthesia, Twelve Labs and Flawless etc. developing similar models to
[COMPANY] for the purpose of product video insertions and scene
understanding - hope we can find time to connect.

A bit of context on Encord - we help over 200 AI teams improve data quality
for model development. We focus on consolidating data curation, annotation
and model evaluation with the goals of efficiency gains for training
dataset preparation & model iterations.

Would you be open to a coffee & exchange perspectives? We'll be at the
conference Friday (6/13) to Sunday (6/15). If virtual is easier, happy to
find a time that suits you!

subject: Scale AI news
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

With Meta's $15B deal with ScaleAI, there's growing urgency around scalable, high-quality data infrastructure - & as we're seeing a wave of strong inbound demand - thought i'd reach out to explore if we can help in a similar way.

I lead the AV team here at Encord, and we've been working with a number of your AV peers (Woven, Wayve, Motional etc) to provide the front-end to visualise, curate, & annotate multimodal training data - supporting AV/ADAS validation flows.

Curious to understand how you are thinking about training data / verification pipelines at [COMPANY] - & also happy to share our thoughts on where we see the industry heading.

Let me know if you're be open to a 30-minute chat later this week? Thursday or Friday quite open for me at the moment,
